title: koala-kollect-data v1
description: One record per JSONL line. Each data file holds one record type, named in manifest.json. Validate a line against #/$defs/<type>.

site.description: The official card-list site a fact was read from. asia-en and tc are retired: no row carries them, and their printings are in retired_printings (CONTRACT.md, Retired sites).

printing_site.description: Where a printing, its locator, a DON card's observation or a run was read: an official site, or tcgcsv for DON cards and Release Event stamps. No official site lists DON cards, so tcgcsv is their only source (alyssa 87523: the TCGplayer product name is the observed name). Release Event stamped prints are listed only by TCGplayer (Mike, dm-alyssa 88048); their card's facts and observations stay on the official sites. Never a product site.

run_site.description: Where a run read: a printing site, or a site retired since (asia-en, tc, retired 2026-10-10; CONTRACT.md, Retired sites). Runs are the audit record, so the runs a retired site made before its retirement stay valid. A run of a retired site started after its retirement is refused by scripts/check.py, and run() never makes one.

run_product_key.description: A product key named by a run: a live product key, or one on a site retired since (run_site). Runs keep what they wrote when they wrote it.

distribution_site.description: Where a distribution was read: an official site, or tcgcsv for a Release Event group (one distribution per TCGplayer RE group). Its own def, not $defs/site: product.site refs that one, and tcgcsv is never a product site.

date.description: A calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD. Every release date on the product indexes is a full date (238 of 238, 2026-10-08).

partial_date.description: Day, month or year precision, for distribution events. JP magazine inserts often carry only a month.

product_key.description: {site}:{series_id}, e.g. jp:550117, cn:OPC-16; or {site}:src_ + 12 hex of sha1({site}|{source_text}) for a product minted from source_text.

set_code.description: A set code in its global form: OP-09, EB-04, ST-31, PRB-02, or P for promos.

set_key.description: A set's key, equal to its code.

attribute.description: As printed. "?" is printed in place of an attribute (OP13-079 Imu): half-width on en, full-width on jp. Both are stored as half-width "?"; full-width is refused.

card.description: Rules identity. Canonical facts come from one site's observation, jp first (JP is the authority), then en, cn, and tcgcsv for DON; every site's own reading is kept in card_observation. Natural key: number for numbered cards, don_design for DON cards (Mike 86397: each DON design is its own card; normal and gold of one design are printings of it).

number.description: OP01-001, P-117, ST20-004. Unique where present. Absent on DON cards, which carry don_design instead.

don_design.description: DON cards only: {TCGplayer group abbreviation}:{slug of the normal product's name}, e.g. OP09:don-card-alternate-art. Unique, set once at mint and never rewritten. Art is not measured, so this over-splits: the same art reissued in another group is a second card until art is measured. Normal and gold of one design share this card and differ as printings.

block_icon.description: DERIVED: the block number printed on the facts site's base printing, for filtering by block. When the facts site has no base printing: that site's value if every one of its printings for the card agrees, else omitted, because the card-level value would be ambiguous. Never "X"; the fact of record is printing.block_icon, which can differ by printing and by site.

facts_site.description: Which source's current reading supplied the canonical facts. Fallback order: jp, en, cn, tcgcsv (the first site with an observation wins), so a card with no JP printing still has facts. DON cards only may carry tcgcsv: no official site lists DON cards (0 on all five, 2026-10-08), so their facts come from tcgcsv.

card_observation.description: One site's reading of a card (facts AND text), versioned by content hash. A changed block closes the old row (superseded_at) and opens a new one, so errata windows keep a record.

observation_hash.description: First 16 hex of sha256 over the parsed block, not the raw page HTML.

types.description: As printed, in the site's language.

printing.description: One physical print as one site lists it. Never deleted and carries no removed_at: where it is listed lives on printing_product, and a printing moves between series pages under the same image id.

rarity.description: As printed: C, UC, R, SR, SEC, L, P, SP, ...

variant.description: tcgcsv printings only use normal, foil, gold and stamped. DON printings use normal, foil and gold: normal and foil are the two finishes of a normal DON product (TCGplayer's Normal and Foil price rows, two physical cards, alyssa 87481), gold is the gold DON product's printing, and gold is always foil. stamped is a Release Event stamped print of a numbered card, never a DON.

image_url.description: Absolute URL with no query string or fragment: the official site's, or TCGplayer's image for a tcgcsv DON printing. Required on every official site's printing. Omitted on a tcgcsv printing whose product TCGplayer has no image for (imageCount 0, where its CDN answers 403), until it has one (upper 87556). Bandai appends a site-wide deploy stamp (?260929) that changes on every redeploy; keeping it would make every printing differ on every run. Linked, never re-hosted.

provenance_url.description: tcgcsv printings only, optional: the Bandai en page image this printing's TCGplayer image was matched to, linking the card to the publisher's own copy (Mike, DON provenance arc). Written only for a measured match: mean absolute pixel difference about 5/255 against TCGplayer's image (CONTRACT.md, DON). Linked, never re-hosted. Never on an official site's printing.

source_text.description: The verbatim Card Set(s) / 入手情報 / 獲取方法 string, unparsed, so a better parser can re-derive without a re-scrape. Empty string when the site shows none (EN ST14-010_r1 has no provenance block); every empty one is counted on the run.

block_icon.description: The block icon as printed on this printing on this site: an integer, "X" (never rotates out of standard), or null where the site prints none (a dash or empty). Sites can disagree on the same image id, and parallels of one card number can differ, so this is per printing per site.

number_token.description: cn only. What cn writes after the base card number, verbatim: _NN (P-084_01) or inline (P, SP, LP, CP, -03, P-R, P-SR). The card is keyed on the base number; the token is evidence for variant. Absent when cn writes none.

image_token.description: cn only. What the image file name carries after the base number, verbatim (OP06-050P.png -> P, OP01-016_06.png -> _06). Absent when the name carries the bare number, or no number at all (a hash name says nothing).

image_hash.description: Perceptual hash of the printing's art region, '{algo}:{hex}', written by the hash job. Evidence for design matching only, never an identity. Absent until hashed; a missing hash is a counted gap.

variant.description: cn infers variant from three signals and never emits reprint (alyssa 87295).

then.description: A tcgcsv printing is a DON (rarity DON, variant normal, foil or gold) or a Release Event stamp (variant stamped, any rarity but DON). Nothing else.

not.description: provenance_url links a tcgcsv printing to Bandai's copy; an official site's printing is Bandai's copy.

variant.description: normal and foil are the two finishes of a tcgcsv DON product and stamped is a tcgcsv Release Event print, and nothing else: an official site's printing never carries them (codex, PR 15).

printing_locator.description: Where a printing is found on its site. Measured stable (roberto 86390: 55 EN and 48 JP weekly snapshots, no id moved or vanished), so one row per printing in practice; the table exists so a future renumber is a new row, not a new printing.

image_id.description: Site-local. Bandai sites: base number plus an optional _pN or _rN suffix (OP14-108_p3, P-001_p5, ..._r1), measured stable per site. cn: the API's numeric id, an ASSUMPTION not yet measured (the cn list also carries its own suffixed cardNumber such as P-084_01). Suffixes do not line up across sites. tcgcsv: {TCGplayer productId}:{finish}, the finish as TCGplayer's price row names it, Normal or Foil (alyssa 87481): always present, so a product that gains a second finish never rekeys.

suffix_family.description: Absent when the id has no suffix or the site has none (cn).

product.description: A series page on one site: a sealed product, or a listing bucket such as promos; or a product minted from a bucket printing's source_text (key {site}:src_..., no series_id; CONTRACT.md, Promo origin). release_date and release_date_source come together. limited and promo_bucket rows are card pools and carry no date; a minted product is an origin, not a pool, so it may carry one (with its source) whatever its kind.

allOf.$comment: A card pool carries no date. A minted product (key {site}:src_) is an origin, not a pool: a date is allowed, not required, and dependentRequired still pairs it with its source.
Only a minted product (key {site}:src_ + 12 hex) goes without series_id; every other product is keyed {site}:{series_id} and carries it.

series_id.description: 550117, 569901, OPC-16. Absent only on a product minted from source_text.

is_bucket.description: true on the six catch-all series (each site's promo_bucket and limited series): card pools, not products. Absent elsewhere, never false.

release_date.description: This site's release date, read from the site's own product index. Never from tcgcsv.

release_date_source.description: The product page whose entry on the site's product index carried release_date: an en or jp /products/ page, or a cn page (CONTRACT.md, Promo origin).

printing_product.description: A printing listed under a series page. Many-to-many (one id sits under two pages today). removed_at lives HERE: a printing leaving the promo page for Other Product Card closes this row and opens another, the printing itself is unchanged.

removed_at.description: Set only by a clean run (no fetch error, nonzero parse) that no longer finds the listing. Never deleted.

distribution.description: Where a printing came from: the pack a site's card list names in source_text, one per (site, source_text). Tier, dates and quantity are not here: they live on each printing_distribution claim, one claim per source page.

key.description: dist_ + mint of {site}|{source_text}; for tcgcsv, of tcgcsv|{TCGplayer group name}.

stamp_color.description: The stamp colour of a prize pack's cards (gold, black, ...), set at review. A design's stamp colour is read through its printings' distributions, never stored on the design.

stamp_color_source.description: Where stamp_color was read: the competition page's URL, or the literal reviewed when it was read from the card in hand (cn prize images carry a watermark over the stamp).

region.description: TCGplayer is a North American catalogue (CONTRACT, Release dates), so a tcgcsv distribution is region en.

kind.description: A tcgcsv distribution is one TCGplayer Release Event group, so it is an event_pack (codex, PR 17). Pre-Release groups are out of scope; admitting them is a change here.

printing_distribution.description: One claim that a printing came from a distribution, with the source and the exact quote. Several claims per printing are normal and may disagree (P-157); the UI ranks them, the data keeps them all.

key.description: ev_ + first 16 hex of sha256(printing_key|distribution_key|source|source_url), so a re-run upserts instead of duplicating.

tier.description: Who got it, as this source page states it: the prize heading nearest above the line naming the pack.

starts_on.description: The event date this source page prints, or the date inside the card list's own pack name.

quantity_note.description: The quantity verbatim as the source page prints it, e.g. x1 or 2パック.

design.description: data/designs.jsonl. One art of one card, across every language it was printed in (CONTRACT.md, Designs). The app joins printings to it through printing_designs.

stamp.description: The stamp text verbatim, when the design is a stamped one. Stamped and unstamped are different designs.

exclusive_override.description: Set at review only, for a design the derived language-exclusive test gets wrong.

printing_design.description: data/printing_designs.jsonl. Which design a printing is an instance of. At most one row per printing, so the key is the printing's key; a printing with no row is unreviewed.

method.description: suffix_and_rarity only proposes; image_hash decides; manual is a hand review.

set.description: data/sets.jsonl. A set in its global form, one row per code, across every language. A printing's set is read from its card number; this table only names the sets products are labelled with (CONTRACT.md, Sets).

product_set.description: data/product_sets.jsonl. Which sets a product carries. Many-to-many: a two-deck starter carries two sets, an en compound code (OP14-EB04) carries both its OP and its EB set.

retired_printing.description: data/retired_printings.jsonl. A printing that should never have been minted, removed from the data by a reviewed PR. The app sync deletes the printing it names and every row that points at it (printing_products, printing_distributions, printing_locators, printing_links), matched on the printing key. The ingest refuses to write a retired printing again, and the check refuses a key that is both a live printing and retired.

key.description: Equal to printing_key; the app sync and the check refuse a row where they differ.

printing_key.description: The retired printing. Not a reference: its printing row is gone.

reason.description: duplicate_source_record: the source listed one printing under two ids, and the later id had been minted a printing of its own (cn, CONTRACT.md). site_retired: the printing's site is retired, and every printing it carried goes (CONTRACT.md, Retired sites).

source_ids.description: The locators that show it, the retired printing's own first. duplicate_source_record: then the locator of the printing it duplicates (two or more). site_retired: its own locator only (exactly one).

don_set.description: data/don_sets.jsonl. Which set page a DON card sits on, one row per DON card. DON carry no number, so no set can be read off them: the tcgcsv walker places each card by its TCGplayer group, by an override where the product names another product, or on the promo page (CONTRACT.md, DON sets). Placement within the page is the app's.

key.description: The DON card's key. The check refuses a key that is no DON card.

printing_keys.description: Every tcgcsv printing of the card, sorted. The check refuses a list that differs from the card's printings.

don_design.description: The card's don_design, for readers and checks only.

set_slug.description: The app's set slug: an en product code lowercased (dp-06, op14-eb04, prb-01), or promo.

source.description: group: the card's TCGplayer group is that en product. override: the product's name names another product, or a DON with no en product sits on promo. promo: a TCGplayer promo group (OP-PR, OP-DD, ST-01 PRE), set_slug promo.

ingest_run.description: Data-repo audit only (runs/), not synced to the app. A page with any refusal never stamps removed_at.

blocks_without_source_text.description: Parsed blocks with no provenance string. A jump between runs means the parser broke, not that Bandai removed the field.

count_drop.description: Pages whose parsed block count fell more than 10% below their last clean run.

count_mismatch.description: Pages whose parsed count disagrees with an independent block count in the same HTML.

unpriced.description: tcgcsv only. DON products and Release Event stamps with no price row, so no finish and no key: refused, never minted, and minted on the first run that sees a price row (upper 87490). The run line names them by productId.

no_image.description: tcgcsv only. DON products and Release Event stamps written this run with no image on TCGplayer (imageCount 0), so their printings carry no image_url yet. The run line names them by productId.

unmatched.description: tcgcsv only. Release Event stamps whose Number is no card of ours: refused, never minted (CONTRACT.md, Release Event stamps). The run line names them by productId. Absent on runs before the stamps walker.

rarity_disagreements.description: tcgcsv only. Release Event stamps written this run whose TCGplayer rarity differs from their card's en base printing. The stamp keeps TCGplayer's rarity verbatim; this counts where it differs. Absent on runs before the stamps walker.

variant_disagreements.description: cn only. Printings written this run whose variant signals (number token, image token, name marker) did not all agree. Any one present makes the printing a parallel; this counts the rows where that call rested on less than all of them (alyssa 87295).

cn_duplicate_ids.description: cn only. Listed cn ids that are a second save of a lower id's printing: list row and detail equal apart from id, createTime and updateTime. Each is a second locator on that printing and mints nothing. Named on every run, so a new double-save shows as a new id.

manifest.description: manifest.json at the repo root. The app sync reads this first and refuses on any sha256 or row-count mismatch.
